players.product: grid-scale battery energy storage (BESS) for data-center/grid power

quarterly_data.signal: Fluence's key operating metrics as of June 30, 2026: energy storage contracted backlog 12.6 GW, up 38% from 9.1 GW at September 30, 2025; deployed 7.4 GW (19.3 GWh); energy storage pipeline 45.6 GW (+28%) or 163.7 GWh (+34%) versus September 30, 2025. Fluence expects to recognize approximately 48% to 53% of its remaining performance obligations as revenue in the next 12 months.
quarterly_data.figure: contracted backlog 12.6 GW (+38% vs 9.1 GW at September 30, 2025); deployed 7.4 GW / 19.3 GWh; pipeline 45.6 GW / 163.7 GWh; 48% to 53% of RPO within 12 months

quarterly_data.signal: As of June 30, 2026 Fluence's minimum purchase commitments under master supply agreements, primarily for battery cells and modules, total $2,913,439 thousand ($1,101,103 thousand in fiscal 2027 and $1,002,324 thousand in fiscal 2028), with $396,267 thousand of liquidated damages if minimum volumes or spend are not met. On May 5, 2026 Fluence provided a $30.0 million working capital loan to one of its suppliers (not named) in connection with a master supply agreement for the purchase of battery cells.
